summary: Changes an earlier ordinance so Metro accepts about 3,725 feet of eight-inch sewer main, about 1,709 feet of six-inch sewer force main, a pump station and 33 manholes with easements at 7375 Nolensville Road in Williamson County. This updates the Nolensville Town Square - Phase 1 project, adding one manhole and about 96 feet of eight-inch main and removing about 143 feet of force main.
